user_query: I'm planning a surprise anniversary party for my parents and I need some ideas for decorations and party games. Can you suggest some trending memes and top quality memes that can be used as themes for the party? Additionally, I would like to gather information about rising popular posts on Reddit to ensure a fun and memorable celebration.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of trending memes suitable for party themes.
Gather a collection of top quality memes that can be used at the party.
Explore Reddit for rising popular posts relevant to party games and decorations.
required_inputs: most upvoted posts in party themes

TaskList.description: Combine the information from all previous tasks to create a comprehensive list of decoration ideas and party games based on memes.
